sloka: उत्पन्ना तु कथम् बुद्धिस्तवेयम् पापदर्शिनि ।साधुचारित्रविभ्राष्टे पूर्वेषाम् नो विगर्हिता ॥२-७३-१९॥
transliteration: utpannā tu katham buddhistaveyam pāpadarśini ।sādhucāritravibhrāṣṭe pūrveṣām no vigarhitā ॥2-73-19॥

translations.english: O woman of sinful thoughts fallen from virtuous conduct, how did you entertain this thought reproachable to our ancestors?
